fightSong.title: Sweet
fightSong.lyrics: Georgia peach, sweet as can be / Atlanta football, come and see / Fuzzy outside, hard inside / Peaches got that southern pride!

stadium.name: The Orchard
stadium.tradition: The Pit Spit — a peach pit spitting contest at halftime. Winner gets season tickets. Record: 63 feet.

fanCulture.description: They bring actual peaches. After touchdowns they do the 'peach fuzz' dance. Sweet but they'll fight you.
fanCulture.tailgate: Peach cobbler, BBQ, and traffic complaints.

rivalries.name: The Southern Run
rivalries.narrative: They run shine, we grow peaches.

cityFlavor: Peaches, traffic, and hip-hop. The south got something to say.
